graph.name: review
graph.description: Plan, implement, review in parallel, then ask a person.

revision.source:
apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1
kind: Graph
name: review
description: Plan, implement, review in parallel, then ask a person.

inputs:
  instruction: {required: true, description: The change to make}

plan:
  planner:
    agent: claude
    prompt: "Plan: ${instruction}"

implementation:
  implementer:
    agent: {same: planner}
    prompt: "Implement the plan: ${outputs.planner}"

review:
  reviewers:
    agent: {not: implementer}
    facets:
      - {facet: security, model: elevated}
      - {facet: bugs, model: default}
    prompt: "Review the change for ${item.facet.name}"
  reranker:
    agent: {same: implementer}
    prompt: "Consolidate: ${json(outputs.reviewers)}"
  ship:
    human: "Ship this change?"
